polarity_null_flips_sign.reference: minus its input, exact negation of both profiles

layer_shuffle_null_permutes.reference: sorted values of the input, the multiset a permutation keeps

uniform_gain_null_scales.reference: input times the seeded generator's first uniform(0.1, 1) draw

synchrony_metric_limits.reference: closed form: identical channels 1; one complementary pair r = -1, clipped to 0

null_samples_closed_form.reference: n = ceil(1 + 1/(2 rse^2)): 3, 5, 9 and 33 samples at rse 0.5, 0.4, 0.25 and 0.125

spectrolaminar_score_known_profile.reference: 100 for an ideal readout; 100 exp(-3 x 0.8) for the reversed profile (MSE 0.4 per band)

box_projection_is_clip.reference: np.clip of each row to [lows, highs]

sdr_quadratic_minimum.reference: closed-form trajectory: ||x_100 - x*|| / ||x_0 - x*|| = 0.8^100 from x_0 = 0, x* = (1, -2, 0.5, 3); error = relative deviation from 0.8^100; inner optax.sgd(0.1), noise off

gsdr_quadratic_minimum.reference: closed-form trajectory: ||x_100 - x*|| / ||x_0 - x*|| = 0.8^100 from x_0 = 0, x* = (1, -2, 0.5, 3); error = relative deviation from 0.8^100; inner optax.sgd(0.1), noise off

agsdr_quadratic_minimum.reference: independent float64 NumPy recurrence of the transform update (U_t = (1 - a_t) D_t, D_t = -0.1 grad_t, a_0 = 0.5, v_{t+1} = 0.99 v_t + 0.01 var(D_t), a_{t+1} = clip((u + eps) / (u + v_{t+1} + 2 eps)), u = 0, eps = 1e-6; loss falls every step so no deselection reset fires); error = max|x_core - x_ref| / max|x_0 - x*|; inner optax.sgd(0.1), noise off; experimental transform

gsgd_quadratic_minimum.reference: closed-form trajectory: ||x_100 - x*|| / ||x_0 - x*|| = 0.8^100 from x_0 = 0, x* = (1, -2, 0.5, 3); error = relative deviation from 0.8^100; eta 0.1

dropped.phase_null_keeps_power: phase_randomized_null multiplies each entry by the cosine of an independent uniform angle (jaxfne/objectives.py). Its inputs are band-power profiles, not time series, so a spectral invariant does not apply; no check was written for it.
dropped.optax_adam_quadratic_minimum: optax_adam returns an OptimizerSpec declaration (jaxfne/optim/core.py); its update runs only inside Model.tune(), not on a plain function, so a quadratic run would test optax, not core code.
